title: Transform into QubeYards real estate platform with buy/sell/rent, admin approvals, news section, and partner currency rewards

requirements.text: Add transaction type field (buy, sell, rent) to property data model in backend and update all property-related functions to support this field
acceptanceCriteria: Property type includes transaction type field with options: buy, sell, rent
All existing property functions handle transaction type correctly
Transaction type is required when creating or updating properties

requirements.text: Add pan-India location support by updating property location field to accept any Indian city/state and display pan-India coverage in the UI
acceptanceCriteria: Properties can be listed from any location in India
Location filter supports Indian cities and states
UI indicates pan-India coverage availability

requirements.text: Create an offers display section on the main dashboard showing a single prominent offer line that highlights current deals or promotions

quotes: offers ki ek line honi chahiye

acceptanceCriteria: Offers section is visible on the main dashboard
Display shows one prominent offer line
Offer text is clear and attention-grabbing

requirements.text: Add project stage categorization (pre-launch, launch, ready-to-shift) to property data model and implement filtering by project stage in the property listing interface

quotes: pre launch project launch project, ready to shift project

acceptanceCriteria: Property model includes project stage field with options: pre-launch, launch, ready-to-shift
Property list can be filtered by project stage
Project stage is displayed on property cards
All three stages are selectable in filters

requirements.text: Implement admin role system in backend with functions to designate admin users and restrict property approval and edit operations to admin role only

quotes: approval or edit ka option sirf admin par he ho

acceptanceCriteria: Admin role is defined in backend user system
Only admins can approve pending property listings
Only admins can edit any property details
Non-admin users receive error when attempting admin operations

requirements.text: Add property approval workflow where new property listings require admin approval before becoming visible to all users, with pending status for unapproved properties

quotes: project list koi bhi kare but approval or edit ka option sirf admin par he ho

acceptanceCriteria: New property listings start in pending approval status
Admins see a list of pending properties requiring approval
Approved properties become visible in main property list
Property submitters can see their pending submissions

requirements.text: Create a news and magazine section accessible from main navigation that displays real estate news articles, industry updates, and magazine-style content

quotes: hamare news magine ka option ho

acceptanceCriteria: News/Magazine link appears in main navigation
News section displays articles in magazine-style layout
Articles include headlines, images, and publication dates
Content is organized and easy to browse

requirements.text: Implement QubeYards currency reward system in backend that tracks and awards currency points to partners when they list properties or provide referrals

quotes: Jo property list karega ya refrance dega usko QubeYards currency show hogi uski id m

acceptanceCriteria: Partner profile includes QubeYards currency balance field
Currency is awarded when partner lists a property
Currency is awarded when partner provides a referral
Currency transactions are logged with timestamps and reasons

requirements.text: Display QubeYards currency balance prominently in the partner's dashboard and profile, showing total earned currency and recent currency transactions

quotes: QubeYards currency show hogi uski id m

acceptanceCriteria: Currency balance is visible on partner dashboard
Balance shows total QubeYards currency earned
Recent currency transactions are listed with details
Currency icon or branding is used consistently

requirements.text: Restrict channel partner features (QubeYards Partner section) so that only authenticated users with partner role can access partner-specific functionality like property listing submission and currency tracking

quotes: channel partner (QubeYards partner) ka option ho ye sirf channel partner ke liye hoga

acceptanceCriteria: Partner-specific features require partner role authentication
Non-partners cannot access partner dashboard sections
Partner role is assigned during registration or by admin
Role-based access control is enforced on backend

requirements.text: Update branding throughout the application to use QubeYards name, logo, and identity consistently across all pages, navigation, and communications

quotes: QubeYards name se ek real estate company ka app banao

acceptanceCriteria: App name is QubeYards across all pages
Navigation and footer display QubeYards branding
Page titles and metadata reference QubeYards
Consistent brand identity is maintained

requirements.text: Create a modern, premium visual design system for QubeYards with a sophisticated color palette featuring deep teals, golds, and whites that conveys luxury real estate brand positioning with clean typography and professional property imagery
acceptanceCriteria: Color scheme uses premium teal, gold, and white tones
Typography is clean and professional
Layout feels luxurious and modern
Design conveys trust and sophistication
Visual hierarchy guides user attention effectively

constraints: Admin role must be enforced at backend level, not just UI
Property approval workflow must prevent unapproved listings from appearing in public property list
Partner authentication must use Internet Identity system already implemented
QubeYards currency system must track all transactions with audit trail
Do not modify Internet Identity authentication implementation in frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts
nonGoals: Real-time chat or messaging between partners and users

required: QubeYards company logo with modern real estate aesthetic in teal and gold colors (qubeyards-logo.dim_200x80.png)
Luxury real estate hero banner showing premium property with modern architecture (hero-luxury.dim_1920x600.png)
News and magazine section header image with real estate theme (news-header.dim_1200x400.png)
QubeYards currency coin icon in gold with company branding (currency-icon.dim_128x128.png)
